title: Accessible navigation, dialogs and clearer recovery
description: Fixes all six findings from the October 21 design review: workspace skip navigation moves keyboard focus to the main content; long dialogs scroll within short windows; the ruleset draft selector keeps a visible label; error screens provide retry and workspace recovery; contributor results use shared semantic status colors; and operational metadata, chart labels and source text scale with the browser's text size.
upgrade: Rebuild and restart the web service.
